AI-Tools.title: AI Tools
AI-Tools.content:
Claude (3.7 Sonnet)
My best friend for coding questions. Not as good as GPT models at actually explaining what to do, but noticeably better with code. The limits even with the pro version are extremely frustrating though.
ChatGPT (4o)
Great for writing. Give it a stream of consciousness thought dump and ask it to make it clear, concise and organized, then iterate from there. Saves me an incredible amount of time during the week.
Cursor
Auto-complete and chat are incredible. I feel like I’m scratching the surface here but I love it.
Superwhisper
I keep on forgetting to use this speech to text tool. Going to need more time.

Making-My-Website.title: Making My Website
Making-My-Website.content:
I have always wanted to make a personal website that I felt proud of. As someone who is not technical (yet…), I now have that opportunity due to the progress of AI Tools. Shoutout Claude and Cursor for being the best combo I have found thus far. I never felt like I could really bring my ideas to life but now I can.
Lately, I have also been feeling the urge to write more, so when I stumbled across Quartz, it seemed like the perfect project for my current interests.
Here are some of the things I did to get this site off the ground that seem trivial to a developer but I’m proud of:

Created my own Quartz repo in Github
Learned how to push a Github commit
Switched hosting platforms form Squarespace to Cloudflare
Set up an automatic deployment for updates to my prod branch
Used Quartz to connect Obsidian to my site

Here are some of the things I did to make my site custom:

Added a gradient background for light (sunrise) and dark (sunset) mode
Added a gently swaying palm tree to my background
Hid the date and article-title from my homepage
Updated the favicon of my homepage

We’ll see where this project goes but I am proud of this site. It was fun to learn some front-end engineering.
Shoutouts

AI for making code less daunting and allowing me to build things.
Jacky Zhao for working on Quartz and Sunlit, the inspiration for the gently swaying palm tree.

index.title: Riley's Space
index.content:
Welcome!
I’m Riley. This is my corner of the internet — a space for thoughts, explorations, and whatever else I decide to put here.
Why This Exists
I’m not entirely sure yet. This digital space might become:

A collection of ideas and projects
Notes on things I’m learning
A portfolio of creative work
Something completely unexpected

What You’ll Find
For now, this is a blank canvas. As I figure out how I want to use this space, you’ll find new pathways and content appearing over time.
Explore
If you’re curious, you can always:

Check back later to see what’s grown here
Follow the connections in the Graph View
